//! Baseline measurement source for humantime 2.4.0, retained for audit only.

use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use std::path::Path;
use std::time::Duration;

use humantime::{format_duration, parse_duration};
use serde_json::{Value, json};

#[test]
#[ignore = "records the dependency baseline before replacement"]
fn measure_duration_baseline() {
    let root = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../..");
    let mut literals = BTreeSet::new();
    for path in ["examples", "docs/src", "crates"] {
        collect_literals(&root.join(path), &mut literals);
    }
    let mut inputs = literals.clone();
    for unit in [
        "nanos", "nsec", "ns", "usec", "us", "µs", "millis", "msec", "ms", "seconds", "second",
        "secs", "sec", "s", "minutes", "minute", "min", "mins", "m", "hours", "hour", "hr", "hrs",
        "h", "days", "day", "d", "weeks", "week", "wk", "wks", "w", "months", "month", "M",
        "years", "year", "yr", "yrs", "y",
    ] {
        for n in [
            "0",
            "1",
            "2",
            "17",
            "1.5",
            "0.0",
            "0.000000001",
            "18446744073709551615",
            "18446744073709551616",
        ] {
            for separator in ["", " ", "\t", "\u{2003}"] {
                inputs.insert(format!("{n}{separator}{unit}"));
            }
        }
        inputs.insert(format!("1{unit}2s"));
        inputs.insert(format!("1 {unit} 2s"));
    }
    for input in [
        "",
        " ",
        "\t\n",
        "0",
        "00",
        " 0",
        "0 ",
        "1",
        "-1s",
        "+1s",
        "s",
        "1fortnight",
        "1S",
        "1μs",
        "1µ",
        "1 sec min",
        "1m sec",
        "1.s",
        ".1s",
        "1..2s",
        "1,5s",
        "1.0000000001s",
        "0.000123456789s",
        "1.00000000000000000000s",
        "1.1ns",
        "0.5ns",
        "0.5us",
        "0.0001h",
        "0.5h",
        "1 2s",
        "1.2 3s",
        "1\n2s",
        "1s!",
        "1s  !",
        "1. s",
        "1. s2s",
        "1. 2 s",
        "1.2",
        "1s2",
        "1s 2",
        "1s\u{2003}2µs",
        "18446744073709551615s 1ns",
        "18446744073709551615s 999999999ns",
        "18446744073709551614s 1000000000ns",
        "18446744073709551615s 1s",
        "18446744073709551615ns 1ns",
        "18446744073709551us",
        "18446744073709552us",
        "18446744073709ms",
        "18446744073710ms",
        "307445734561825860m",
        "307445734561825861m",
    ] {
        inputs.insert(input.to_owned());
    }
    let parse: Vec<Value> = inputs
        .iter()
        .map(|input| {
            let result = match parse_duration(input) {
                Ok(d) => json!({"secs": d.as_secs(), "nanos": d.subsec_nanos()}),
                Err(e) => json!({"error": format!("{e:?}"), "message": e.to_string()}),
            };
            json!({"input": input, "result": result})
        })
        .collect();
    let mut durations = BTreeSet::new();
    for boundary in [
        0,
        1,
        60,
        3600,
        86400,
        604800,
        2630016,
        31557600,
        63115200,
        u64::MAX,
    ] {
        for secs in [
            boundary.saturating_sub(1),
            boundary,
            boundary.saturating_add(1),
        ] {
            for nanos in [
                0, 1, 999, 1000, 1001, 999999, 1000000, 1000001, 123456789, 999999999,
            ] {
                durations.insert((secs, nanos));
            }
        }
    }
    let format: Vec<Value> = durations.into_iter().map(|(secs, nanos)| {
        json!({"secs": secs, "nanos": nanos, "output": format_duration(Duration::new(secs, nanos)).to_string()})
    }).collect();
    let table = json!({"baseline": "humantime 2.4.0", "literals": literals, "parse": parse, "format": format});
    let path = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/duration_golden.json");
    std::fs::write(path, serde_json::to_string_pretty(&table).unwrap() + "\n").unwrap();
    println!(
        "MEASURE literals={} parse={} format={}",
        table["literals"].as_array().unwrap().len(),
        table["parse"].as_array().unwrap().len(),
        table["format"].as_array().unwrap().len()
    );
}

fn collect_literals(path: &Path, literals: &mut BTreeSet<String>) {
    if path.is_dir() {
        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(path).unwrap() {
            collect_literals(&entry.unwrap().path(), literals);
        }
    } else if matches!(
        path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()),
        Some("rs" | "md" | "toml" | "yaml" | "json")
    ) {
        let text = std::fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap();
        for part in text.split(['"', '`', '\n']) {
            if part.chars().next().is_some_and(|c| c.is_ascii_digit())
                && parse_duration(part).is_ok()
            {
                literals.insert(part.to_owned());
            }
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn duration_golden_table() {
    let path = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/duration_golden.json");
    let table: Value = serde_json::from_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap()).unwrap();
    for row in table["parse"].as_array().unwrap() {
        let input = row["input"].as_str().unwrap();
        let actual = match parse_duration(input) {
            Ok(d) => json!({"secs": d.as_secs(), "nanos": d.subsec_nanos()}),
            Err(e) => json!({"error": format!("{e:?}"), "message": e.to_string()}),
        };
        assert_eq!(actual, row["result"], "parse {input:?}");
    }
    for row in table["format"].as_array().unwrap() {
        let duration = Duration::new(
            row["secs"].as_u64().unwrap(),
            row["nanos"].as_u64().unwrap().try_into().unwrap(),
        );
        assert_eq!(
            format_duration(duration).to_string(),
            row["output"].as_str().unwrap(),
            "format {duration:?}"
        );
    }
}
